name: heal_doubling_passive
description: boss-ai A20: a boss passive doubles the boss's healing (a `modify_heal` hook through MatchConfig.boss.hook_installers, `mul` 2). The heal is a Lifesteal 3/3 hitting a 1/5, so the engine's own apply_heal folds it. Boss 8 below full: f_heal 3/8 without the hook, 6/8 with it. No card here has a discover or choose_one op.
